page_title: Esen Tunalı Sarı — Founder & Creative Director
meta_description: Discover the personal story of Esen Tunalı Sarı, the software developer and creative director harmonising artificial intelligence with bespoke jewellery design at SILVER & ELEGANT.
heading: The Creative Technologist

sections.label: Our Story
sections.body: When my family migrated from Bulgaria, the only treasures we could carry were the fragments of our history. Having lived in Bulgaria, Turkey, and the Netherlands before finally settling in the UK, the pieces of jewellery I hold are more than ornaments—they are a map of my life. This journey of resilience and adaptation is the heart of **SILVER & ELEGANT**; it is not merely a brand, but a collection of stories designed to endure.

sections.label: Design Philosophy
sections.body: Our process is a dual practice, where modern technology and traditional craftsmanship hold equal weight. We use generative design to explore complex, architectural forms, and we simultaneously engage in classical design and artisanal production within our Istanbul atelier. It is in this synthesis—where digital precision meets the human hand and the language of metal—that we find the signature balance of **SILVER & ELEGANT**. This is not a transition from one to the other, but a simultaneous integration of both worlds.

We operate at the intersection of architectural minimalism and narrative jewellery. In a world of disposable consumption, **SILVER & ELEGANT** stands for the philosophy of 'Future Heirlooms'—objects crafted with the intent to outlast the fleeting moment of their creation, designed to be passed down through generations.
sections.label: Brand Vision

sections.body:
The brand’s emergence was marked by our participation as a jewellery partner for Paul Costelloe’s Autumn/Winter 2026 opening show at London Fashion Week. This milestone represents a significant step in our commitment to bringing high-concept, architectural jewellery into contemporary fashion.

As a **Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts (FRSA)**, my practice is defined by a dedication to design discipline, cultural heritage, and the continuous search for intellectual depth in aesthetic production.

Esen Tunali Sari, FRSA

Founder & Creative Director, SILVER & ELEGANT
